text: Chunce files a pre-emptive piece on Norman intentions. Editor dismisses it as speculation.
Chunce files copy from Pompeii moments before deadline, and moments before everything else.
Chunce is first on the scene under the Houses of Parliament. Describes the barrels as "probably nothing."
Chunce reports the Great Fire of London as "technically contained."
Chunce covers the signing of a document he describes as "probably fine."
Chunce reports from Waterloo, embedded with both armies simultaneously.
Chunce warns Titanic passengers of "unspecified concerns" regarding the North Atlantic. Editor cuts it for space.
Chunce discovers penicillin while looking for his sandwich. Fleming gets the credit; Chunce gets the sandwich.
Chunce reaches the summit of Everest slightly ahead of the official expedition. Files nothing. Denies it later.
Chunce interviews the Eagle's lunar module before Armstrong disembarks. NASA declines to comment.
Chunce is the only journalist to correctly predict tomorrow's weather. Colleagues ask him to stop.
Chunce embeds with a unit that has not yet been formed. Reports it as a great success.
